wiki.title: Nate Blouin
wiki.extract: Nathan Allen Blouin (born May 16, 1989) is an American politician and climate policy advocate who represents Utah's 13th Senate District in the Utah State Senate. A progressive Democrat, Blouin ran for the Democratic nomination in Utah's 1st congressional district in the 2026 U.S. House elections.
